review_note: agent-built (V2 ALLC, V3 XWALK); not reviewed by a human maintainer
built_by: reva.adapters.connectors.country_crosswalk (V2 step 1, agent ALLC; V3, agent XWALK)
rules: entity per ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (Debian iso-codes mirror, 249 codes), plus World Bank economies without one (not_iso3166: CHI, XKX)
every M49-listed ISO code must agree with ISO 3166-1 (alpha-2, numeric); ISO codes M49 does not list are flagged not_listed_in_un_m49 (TWN) and have no M49 code, region or un_m49 alias
status fields are copied from the sources: iso_name (ISO short name, verbatim), un_membership / un_name / un_admission_date (UN Member States and Non-member States pages); nothing is inferred
label: M49 name, else World Bank name, else ISO common_name, else ISO name (label_source); label_fr only for ISO-derived labels (iso-codes French translation)
CHN/TWN and SRB/XKX carry aggregation_overlap with the UNSD M49 FAQ note (verbatim): within M49 the area (158, 412) is counted in CHN/SRB; REVA never sums or splits them
World Bank rows with region 'Aggregates' are excluded (regions, income and lending groups)

a Comtrade code maps only if: not a group, not a 'nes' area, valid in the window, provider ISO3 field is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, and unique for that ISO3; otherwise it is listed unmapped (490 'Other Asia, nes' is never Taiwan)
a reporter whose provider note lists more areas than its label is mapped but flagged comtrade_territory_note_lists_additional_areas
partner codes are informational only; bilateral rows keep provider partner codes
entities in countries.yaml keep their human-reviewed aliases (reviewed_entry)

aggregation_notes.question: Q: Why is Taiwan Province of China not shown in the M49?
aggregation_notes.quote: On the 25th October 1971, the UN General Assembly adopted a resolution (2758) to recognize the representatives of the Government of the People's Republic of China as the only legitimate representatives of China to the United Nations. As a result, within the M49, Taiwan Province of China is considered part of China (numerical code 156). However, for strictly statistical purposes, the numerical code 158 can be used to represent this area.
aggregation_notes.reva_policy: REVA never sums TWN into CHN nor splits CHN: a provider's CHN may or may not include the area of TWN (see that provider's notes); each row keeps its provider geography and territorial definition.

aggregation_notes.question: Q: Why is Kosovo not shown in the M49?
aggregation_notes.quote: The status of Kosovo should be understood to be in the context of United Nations Security Council resolution 1244 (1999). As a result, within the "Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49)", Kosovo is currently considered part of Serbia (numerical code 688). However, for strictly statistical purposes, the numerical code 412 can be used to represent this area.
aggregation_notes.reva_policy: REVA never sums XKX into SRB nor splits SRB: a provider's SRB may or may not include the area of XKX (see that provider's notes); each row keeps its provider geography and territorial definition.
